PUBLIC SPACE
DONOVAN MARTINEZ

Games, music, Linux, writing, and small software experiments.

This site is a place to collect things I make and things I learn along the way.

It opens as a little computer. The pages live on its disk. You can browse, read, search, and write small BASIC programs without leaving the screen.

GETTING AROUND

F1 opens the disk directory.
Use UP/DOWN and RETURN to open a file.
Use ESC to return to the directory.
Type HELP for all the commands.

Try OPEN PROJECTS or SEARCH MUSIC.

PROGRAMMING

Open HELLO, then type RUN.
Type LIST to see the program.
Change a numbered line and RUN again.

This is a web computer, not a complete hardware emulator. The LINKS file takes you to real browser emulators.
